answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each newcomer bids for a weekly slot, paying twice its 30-day earnings as a deposit, so a place on the ledge of the market is not free. Winners must finish a kernel of verified work within 20 epochs to unlock it. If a gale of 1,000 fake bids arrives, the attacker pays about $24,000, while one honest agent pays $24 once and earns undiluted rewards. Non-finishers lose the deposit, so flooding loses money.
